## ScreenSharingClient interface

The Screen Sharing client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `screenSharingContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [ScreenSharingResources](./screen-sharing_contract.screensharingresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ScreenSharingClient extends ClientBrand<ScreenSharingResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[ScreenSharingResources](./screen-sharing_contract.screensharingresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
